response: Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. Managing complex projects often means rebuilding the same filters and sort orders again and again, and that repetitive setup wastes time your team could spend on actual work. With Saved Views, you can capture any combination of filters, grouping, and sorting as a named view you return to with a single click. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from sprint boards to client-specific task lists to personal priority queues. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating it individually, which keeps reporting and standups consistent across the group. Whether you manage one project or dozens, Saved Views helps you get back to the exact perspective you need without digging through menus or reapplying filters every morning. It's included at no extra cost in all paid plans, starting now. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
